about: D11-2, a company's duties in peace (docs/design/war.md §14.1: a unit always has something to do; D-119). Each names the branches that do it, the skill it uses and its plain reason. Its captain chooses one for his reasons (A.UNITS, A.WHY kind 'duty').

duties.name: the castle watch
duties.why: the gate and the walls want men day and night

duties.name: escorting the tax
duties.why: the tax carts go to the crown this season

duties.name: mending the road and its bridges
duties.why: the road is broken after the winter

duties.name: the lord's errand
duties.why: the lord rides out and wants an escort

duties.name: the drill camp
duties.why: the company is raw, and the season is right for it

duties.name: counting the stores
duties.why: the stores are to be counted before the harvest comes in

duties.name: the harbour watch
duties.why: ships come and go, and some carry trouble

duties.name: the butts on feast days
duties.why: the law wants every bowman at the butts
